source.check: returned unopposed: The Highlands was not among the four divisions polled (Derry Journal, 2 June 1967, p. 1, image read); at the new council's annual meeting 'Mrs. W. E. Conn has been appointed vice-chairman', while the members co-opted were Mr. Nicholl, Dr. MacFlynn and Mr. William O'Hara (Londonderry Sentinel, 5 July 1967, p. 15, image read)

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were polled (Owenreagh, Ballyharrigan, Faughanvale, Drum; Derry Journal, 2 June 1967, p. 1). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 1 June 1961 return (The Highlands: Mrs. Wilhelmina E. Conn, Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 10); the Londonderry Sentinel, 5 July 1967, p. 15 names Mrs. W. E. Conn as vice-chairman of the new council, not among its co-opted members. The 1964 return for The Highlands has not been found. Returned unopposed.
